verdict.rationale: Muse's own docs say you can link email and calendar and control what the agent can see and do, and that it manages email on your behalf (muse-docs-23, muse-docs-38, muse-docs-33). There is no first-party cloud-drive connector; the only path is Muse writing its own custom connector for services with APIs or CLIs (muse-docs-14). That path is generic and unproven for drives. Missing for 10: a documented cloud-drive connector (e.g. Google Drive/Dropbox/OneDrive), explicit docs on searching connected sources to ground answers, and independent hands-on corroboration of the connectors.
